The airflow check of a device (ADR 0049): the rack it is mounted in and the face its front is on, which aisle the rack's front faces (front_aisle), what its model, the device itself (airflow, configured or observed) and its fans and power supplies say about its airflow, and the result: ok (it takes its air in from the cold aisle), mismatch (from the hot aisle: hot air recirculated, the reason says how) or unknown (the reason says which fact is missing). Warnings say when the device or its parts contradict its model (the wrong variant, a fan tray or a power supply turned the other way). The rack contents carry the same check per device.

How sure the inventory is of a device's model, and the models it may be (ADR 0048). certain and reason say what decided the model (declared, sku, model, mounting, part_number) or why it is not certain (base: the name matched a model with chassis variants; airflow; ambiguous: several models fit and none matched; none). candidates are the models of the family the library finds by name and variant_of, with their height and the API paths of their face images. A person chooses one by sending a partial batch that relates the device to the model (instance_of, POST /batches): a declaration wins over the library's match by name and survives later collections; a part number that names another chassis is reported as sku_conflict, not applied. can_choose says whether the caller may send that batch.

The faces of a device's model with its parts in place: the images of the faces, the spots the device-type library knows on them (bays, power supplies, fans, ports, slots), and the device's parts the caller may read, each with the spot it goes in or none when its name does not say. Parts are listed only for the kinds the faces have spots for; absent parts are left out. Empty when the device has no model with images.
